allocation_complete.reason: The BMS-relevant part (permitted discharge power) is covered by BMS_REQ_POWER_DERATING.

completeness.reason: The limit and its BEV refinement are addressed.

consistency.reason: In diesel products the sibling ARCH_ENG_TORQUE_INTERFACE also converts the traction power limit into a torque limit at engine speed; which element owns the conversion is not reconciled (this text speaks of 'motor speed').
consistency.suggestion: State that in diesel products the VCU passes the power limit to ENG, which owns the conversion.

design_clarity.reason: Chooses torque = power limit / speed and min(vehicle, BMS) in bev.

implementability.reason: Zero/low speed (division by zero at standstill) is not bounded.
implementability.suggestion: Define a minimum speed or a torque ceiling for standstill.

interface_only.reason: BMS_REQ_POWER_DERATING is a BMS interface need and allocated only under bev.

no_value_copy.reason: Refers to 'the permitted discharge power published by the BMS' without copying any BMS value.

parent_fit.reason: Implements the traction power limit by torque limiting.

variant_consistency.reason: Ungated like REQ_TRACTION_POWER_LIMIT; the BMS allocation is a `<<bev: ...>>` variant function.
